bump_shape: Key-rate bumps are piecewise-linear tents in the continuously compounded zero rate, centred at 2Y, 5Y, 10Y and 30Y, equal to one at the centre and zero at the neighbouring centres; the 2Y tent is flat (=1) before 2Y and the 30Y tent is flat after 30Y, so the four tents sum to one at every maturity (partition of unity) and the key-rate sensitivities aggregate to the parallel DV01 up to second-order convexity.
